description: Foxconn T99W175 platform under VID 1e2d (Cinterion/Thales MV31, "RmNet based on new baseline"; Dell DW5930e in another modem manager 3.5.8), QMI composition 1e2d:00b9 with QMI on interface 0. Not among the Compal prototype IDs. Interface numbers of the ttys not known to us: no AT interface declared, ModemManager keeps its ttys, no driver binding. Sources: Linux 6.12 qmi_wwan.c (QMI_FIXED_INTF 1e2d:00b9, 0) and option.c (CINTERION_PRODUCT_MV31_2_RMNET), another modem manager 3.5.8 modem/usb/1e2d00b9. Reference only, no bench of ours; profiles audit 2026-10-19

recovery.source: as the 05c6 compositions (foxconn-t99w175-qmi): radio and reset through ModemManager; not bench-validated

radio.source: another modem manager 3.4.0 _qualcomm_sdx55_common (AT^SLMODE mask 1 WCDMA, 2 LTE, 4 NR5G, 0 auto; AT^BAND_PREF=<tech>,2,<list> unquoted, never the bare reset); QModem vendor/foxconn.sh (the same SLMODE table, NR5G_NSA/NR5G_SA lines)

ussd_cs_fallback.source: bench 2026-10-16 (T99W175, Tele2): USSD on LTE fell back to a 3G cell, was rejected (SupsFailureCase) and the data session dropped; ModemManager showed cs 'searching' while eps was 'home'
